# QuickCode

QuickCode creates QR codes whose destinations can be edited after printing. Static QR codes work without an account; dynamic QR codes route through a QuickCode redirect and record only a timestamped scan count. The public site is hosted at https://quickcode-b4y.pages.dev/.

## Privacy
QuickCode does not collect personal or device-identifying scan data. Scan logs contain a count and timestamp only.
